script_text: Aries, the cosmos is about to shake your world this week in ways you never expected. Early week, Mars your ruling planet forms a powerful trine with Jupiter in your 3rd House, igniting bold communication and sharp instincts Monday through Wednesday — but watch Tuesday when Mercury squares your 10th House, creating career tension and miscommunications with authority figures. The turning point arrives Wednesday evening as Venus sextiles your sign, softening relationships and opening a door to unexpected romantic chemistry with someone from your social circle. Thursday through Sunday, the Sun moves into a harmonious trine with your 1st House of identity, fueling confidence and magnetic energy that draws opportunities in love and money. Friday is your power day because the Moon conjuncts your 11th House of wishes, manifesting a financial breakthrough. Sunday is your caution day as Mars opposes Pluto in your 7th House, triggering power struggles in partnerships. Channel your fire element into creative projects and avoid confrontations. Follow for daily updates.
